WITH inserted_account AS (
  INSERT INTO cdp.client_accounts (company_name, domain, status)
  SELECT {{ $json.sql_company ? "'" + $json.sql_company + "'" : 'NULL' }}, {{ $json.sql_domain ? "'" + $json.sql_domain + "'" : 'NULL' }}, 'prospect'
  WHERE {{ $json.sql_company ? 'TRUE' : 'FALSE' }}
  ON CONFLICT (domain) DO UPDATE SET
    company_name = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.company_name, cdp.client_accounts.company_name),
    updated_at = NOW()
  RETURNING id
),
target_account AS (
  SELECT id FROM inserted_account
  UNION ALL
  SELECT id FROM cdp.client_accounts WHERE domain = {{ $json.sql_domain ? "'" + $json.sql_domain + "'" : 'NULL' }} AND {{ $json.sql_domain ? 'TRUE' : 'FALSE' }}
  LIMIT 1
),
upserted_person AS (
  INSERT INTO cdp.persons (first_name, last_name, primary_email, linkedin_url, primary_client_account_id, status)
  VALUES (
    {{ $json.sql_first_name ? "'" + $json.sql_first_name + "'" : 'NULL' }},
    {{ $json.sql_last_name ? "'" + $json.sql_last_name + "'" : 'NULL' }},
    {{ $json.sql_email ? "'" + $json.sql_email + "'" : 'NULL' }},
    {{ $json.sql_profile_url ? "'" + $json.sql_profile_url + "'" : 'NULL' }},
    (SELECT id FROM target_account),
    'active'
  )
  ON CONFLICT (primary_email) DO UPDATE SET
    first_name = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.first_name, cdp.persons.first_name),
    last_name = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.last_name, cdp.persons.last_name),
    linkedin_url = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.linkedin_url, cdp.persons.linkedin_url),
    primary_client_account_id = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.primary_client_account_id, cdp.persons.primary_client_account_id),
    updated_at = NOW()
  RETURNING id
)
UPDATE s_linkedin.connections
SET processed = 1
WHERE id = '{{ $json.sql_connection_id }}';
